subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. The boy, who was passionate about nature, knew that he had to walk away slowly not to alarm the animal.

B. Twelve-year-old Alessandro was wandering among the bushes looking for pine cones, when he appeared to be followed by a bear.

C. Alessandro’s mother panicked when she saw the bear; however, the boy told her to be silent.

D. When he had safely entered his house, the bear stopped following him and disappeared.
solution:
The correct answer is __BACD__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **B** contains the subject of the sentence(**Alessandro**), hence it is the best choice for the **first part.**
